categorical_synthesis: Deterministic conservative ocean updates embed as deterministic morphisms inside the finite Markov category; probabilistic forecasts are stochastic kernels.
WeatherNext 3 equation (3) becomes first-order only after lifting X to the pair-state X x X. The repository now represents this explicitly rather than silently treating WN3 as first-order.

Native-resolution modality maps factor through a shared latent processor object, but that alone does not imply invertibility or exact cross-resolution naturality; both round-trip and naturality defects are explicit diagnostics.
A shared finite noise object induces one coherent field-valued stochastic map. This preserves the distinction between a distribution over functions/fields and independent pointwise perturbations.
A deterministic coarse map Q supports autonomous coarse stochastic dynamics only under strong lumpability KQ=QKc; this is independent of mass conservation.

Korn's pseudo-density continuity supplies the conservative carrier while equations (39), (46), and (47) separate physical tracer/energy dissipation from numerical or AC-induced removal. These are physical observables, not forecast calibration scores.

Pooled CRPS is a statistic after spatial pooling and therefore probes joint/spatial structure that marginal CRPS does not determine; its diagram is distinct from conservation/coarse-graining diagrams.
